candidates.change_summary: Removed the ownership check so anyone can call sendTo, changing who can trigger transfers and thus observable behavior.
Require amount to be strictly greater than 1 instead of > 0, preventing transfers of 1 wei and altering observable transfer outcomes.
Change the transfer target to the owner, so funds always go to owner regardless of provided receiver, altering observed receiver balances.
Add a check that receiver must equal owner, so only transfers to owner succeed, changing which transfers are allowed.
Invert the zero-address check to forbid non-zero addresses (require receiver == address(0)), causing different observable failures/successes.
